description: Track sets: create a related set of tracks in one pass (issue #4)
deviation_notes: Task 5.2 grew into three fresh-agent review rounds (21 findings, then 10 new problems and a Delete gap, then 1). The corrections added a start-gate check to implement §2.0 step 5, removed the Shared Rules section (one Shared Decisions table with sources), added project metadata keys and a generate-and-doctor check to the set workflow, and one Remove a member rule that revert and the implement and review Delete steps use. Finding 10 (fixed phase names for non-code work) is a new-track limit, filed as issue #5. The owner did not review the phases separately: the owner said 'finish it and merge to main when done' and 'push it and close issue 4'.

sprint.goal: A user can ask for a related set of tracks and get them in one pass: one shared questioning phase, one overview page, two review gates, a member template, a dependency record, and one commit.

stories.title: Keep a set current during implement, archive, and revert
Dry run against a real set

sprint.demo_notes: A fresh agent followed new-track-set.md for the Riven Lands request in advantage-forge and produced an overview, a family sample, and a member list in a scratch folder. Two more fresh agents checked the corrections. dry-run.md maps every finding to its correction.
